Questions

What is the median annual wage for Retail supervisors in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 annual median for First-Line Supervisors of Retail Sales Workers in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX is $49,730.

What is the hourly median for Retail supervisors in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 hourly median for First-Line Supervisors of Retail Sales Workers in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX is $23.91.

How many Retail supervisors work in Austin?

OEWS May 2025 estimates 7,950 wage-and-salary First-Line Supervisors of Retail Sales Workers in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX. Self-employed workers are excluded.

What is the location quotient for Retail supervisors in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 location quotient is 0.85. Values above 1.00 mean First-Line Supervisors of Retail Sales Workers are more concentrated in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX than in the national occupational mix.

What is the mean annual wage for Retail supervisors in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 annual mean for First-Line Supervisors of Retail Sales Workers in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX is $54,200.

How does Austin's Retail supervisors median compare to the other WageGrid metros?

Austin's published OEWS May 2025 annual median ($49,730) is $830 higher than Chicago ($48,900) and $12,440 lower than Seattle ($62,170). These are published medians minus published medians. WageGrid does not adjust for cost of living.

Does this wage include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS estimates cover wage-and-salary workers and exclude the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment figure.

Why is a wage cell blank?

BLS withholds some OEWS estimates for quality or confidentiality. WageGrid does not fill those cells.
